gates.declared: Reused UNCHANGED from costmodel.py / weight_search_protocol.md / xgboost_protocol.md. Not redeclared for GraphSAGE -- the whole point of this phase is that GraphSAGE's candidates are held to the identical bar the weight vectors and XGBoost's candidates were.
gates.enforcement: gated_expected_loss() raises PanelGateFailure or DifficultyGateFailure instead of returning a number. An infeasible candidate has no expected loss at all.

node_features: one-hot node type (account/device/ip/instrument) + degree within the component graph, normalised by the matching global cap from config.py -- structural only, deliberately not the linear scorer's 8 signals. See graphsage_protocol.md §2.1.

derivation.manual_review: 20 analyst-minutes per component at INR 1500/hour fully loaded. ASSUMPTION -- the dataset carries no analyst-effort figure.
derivation.false_negative: median ring-component exposure INR 68,399.84 on train+validation, times FN_ABSORBED_FRACTION 1.00
derivation.false_positive: FP_FRICTION_RATE 0.02 of median negative-component exposure INR 19,921.59 -- no separate review cost: the generic (tp+fp)*C_review term already prices one review per flagged component (see deferred_decisions.md D3, resolved Phase 10)

fit_on: train only (selection); gates and threshold sweep both computed on validation predictions only, out-of-sample for every candidate -- train's in-sample scores are never mixed in
